primary-hover.purpose: Hover state of Daylight Blue; always darker so hover means pressing in.

page-bg.purpose: Full-page background; lets white cards lift without visible edges.

surface.purpose: Card surfaces and text on primary fills.

text-strong.purpose: Headings and input values (implied browser default).

text-label.purpose: Form labels, one step softer than Ink.

border.purpose: 1px input borders — quietest border that still reads as a field.

headline.purpose: The single h1 per card — the task title.

label.purpose: Field labels, helper/muted text, error text.

shadows.name: card-ambient
shadows.purpose: Structural only: lifts the one working card off the Stockroom Floor. No hover shadows.

motion.name: card-rise
motion.purpose: The page's one authored moment: the card rises 6px into place on load; prefers-reduced-motion disables it. No second entrance, no scroll-triggered motion.

components.name: Card
components.description: The page's single working surface: white, 12px radius, centered, one ambient shadow.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #ffffff; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 8%); padding: 2rem 2.5rem; text-align: center; max-width: 30rem; } .ds-card h1 { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-size: 1.4rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.95rem; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Daylight Blue fill, white text, weight 500; block variant spans the card in single-action screens. Deepens on hover, fades when disabled.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; padding: 0.55rem 1.25rem; border: none; border-radius: 8px; background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; font-size: 0.95rem; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1d4ed8; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { background: #93c5fd; cursor: wait; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Stacked-label text field: Wire Grey border, Daylight Blue focus ring that replaces the border.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Company name<input class="ds-input" type="text" name="companyName" placeholder="Acme Retail" /></label>
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.25rem; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #374151; text-align: left; } .ds-input { padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid #d1d5db; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 0.95rem; } .ds-input:focus { outline: 2px solid #2563eb; border-color: transparent; }

components.name: Muted helper with link
components.description: Shelf Grey helper line carrying a Daylight Blue link to the sibling screen.
components.html: Already have an account? Sign in
components.css: .ds-muted { color: #6b7280; font-size: 0.85rem; } .ds-link { color: #2563eb; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; }

narrative.overview: An organized-clarity system for a retail back office: a bright, evenly lit space where every item is findable and every state is visible. Pages are single-purpose — one centered white card on a quiet daylight-grey floor — with generous whitespace and no ornament. Color is almost entirely neutral; one blue speaks for every interactive intent (actions, links, focus). There is no motion vocabulary yet — state changes are instant.
keyCharacteristics: One card per page, centered both axes, 26rem wide
Card content left-aligned - the card is centered, its content is not
A single accent blue used for action, focus, and links
One ambient shadow per page, carried by the card only
Footer meta separated by a 1px hairline divider
One authored entrance moment - the card rises into place (reduced-motion respected)
The same system overlays the Keycloak login page (CSS-only theme over stock keycloak.v2 markup)

rules.name: The Single Voice Rule
rules.body: Daylight Blue is the only accent on any screen, shared by buttons, links, and focus rings. A second decorative hue breaks the system.

rules.name: The Shadow-As-Structure Rule
rules.body: Shadow lifts the one working card off the Stockroom Floor — never hover garnish or depth theater.

rules.name: The Instant-State Rule
rules.body: State is shown through fill change, label swap, or red text, instantly - plus the single card-rise entrance. No second motion moment.

dos: Do reuse the one card + one blue voice for every new screen until a real second component is needed
Do keep sizes on the 0.25-2.5rem scale and radii at 8px/12px
Do show state via disabled fill, Ledger Red error text, or swapped label text
donts: Don't add a second accent hue, a webfont, or a hover shadow
Don't invent elevation layers, gradients, or motion vocabulary
Don't exceed 26-30rem card widths or stack a second card on a page without updating this record
